mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.name AS name, m.role AS role, m.recall_admin AS recallAdmin, m.status AS status, m.departed_at AS departedAt FROM memory_project_members m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY CASE m.role WHEN 'OWNER' THEN 0 WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, m.status ASC, m.user_id ASC

SELECT m.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName, m.role AS role, ps.gen_enabled AS ownerEnabled, us.gen_enabled AS memberEnabled FROM memory_project_members m JOIN projects p ON p.id = m.project_id LEFT JOIN memory_project_settings ps ON ps.project_id = m.project_id LEFT JOIN memory_project_user_settings us ON us.project_id = m.project_id AND us.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CASE m.role WHEN 'OWNER' THEN 0 WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, m.project_id ASC
